author: Jim Breem
title: Hedge-Fund Investor raised stakes in Apple Inc. (AAPL) & Facebook Inc (FB) to 3.2 million and 2.2 million shares respectively
text:
Locations February 18, 2018 Hedge-Fund Investor raised stakes in Apple Inc. (AAPL) & Facebook Inc (FB) to 3.2 million and 2.2 million shares respectively 
According to a Wednesday regulatory filing, billionaire hedge-fund investor David Tepper’s Appaloosa Management was a buyer of notable technology, energy and bank stocks in the fourth quarter Between the end of the third and fourth quarter. Acording to filing, Appaloosa boosted its stake in Bank of America Corp.( BAC) by buying shares to up his position in the stock by 170% to 10.8 million shares. 
According to WhaleWisdom.com, David Tepper’s also increased his stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by raising that investment to 3.2 million shares and raising his stake in Micron Technology Inc. (MU) to 10.45 million shares, by showing his largest holding. 
The hedge-fund luminary also lifted his position in Facebook Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) by about 70% to 2.2 million shares, while adding to his holdings in the tech-heavy PowerShares QQQ Trust Series 1 (QQQ) to 4.3 million shares.
